title: Integer density at 0 of a minimizing current invariant along a spine of codimension one or two (Simon 7.3.3(1), display (15), Lemma 3.5)
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (θ₀ : ℝ), Module.finrank ℝ L < n → n ≤ Module.finrank ℝ L + 2 → IsMinimizingIn S univ → BoundaryVanishes S → (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ (w : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ), HasMassDensity S w θ → HasMassDensity S (y + lam • w) θ) → HasMassDensity S 0 θ₀ → ∃ m : ℕ, θ₀ = m
